name: Atmos™ Rewards Ascent Visa Signature® Credit Card

detail.en: eligible Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines purchases, including airfare and in-flight purchases
detail.zh: 符合條件的阿拉斯加航空與夏威夷航空消費，含機票與機上消費

detail.en: eligible gas, EV charging station, local transit, cable and select streaming services purchases
detail.zh: 符合條件的加油、電動車充電、大眾運輸、有線電視與指定串流服務

extra.en: plus a $99 Companion Fare (plus taxes and fees from $23); spend must be within the first 90 days
extra.zh: 另贈 $99 同行票（另付稅費 $23 起）；需於開卡 90 天內達成

detail.en: $100 off an annual Alaska Lounge+ membership paid with the card
detail.zh: 以本卡支付 Alaska Lounge+ 年度會籍，折抵 $100

detail.en: From $122 ($99 plus taxes and fees from $23), issued on your anniversary after $6,000 in purchases that year; for Alaska- or Hawaiian-operated flights within North America, including Hawaii
detail.zh: 該年度消費滿 $6,000，週年時發給；同行者票價 $99 另加稅費 $23 起（合計 $122 起），適用阿拉斯加或夏威夷航空營運的北美航線（含夏威夷）

detail.en: for you and up to 6 guests on the same reservation when the airfare is bought with the card (the page puts this at up to $90 per person round trip)
detail.zh: 以本卡購買機票時，本人與同一訂位最多 6 位同行者適用（官網稱每人來回最多省 $90）

detail.en: for you and up to 6 guests on the same reservation when you pay with the card
detail.zh: 以本卡付款時，本人與同一訂位最多 6 位同行者適用

detail.en: Wi-Fi, drinks and other extras on Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines paid with the card
detail.zh: 以本卡支付阿拉斯加與夏威夷航空機上 Wi-Fi、飲品等消費

highlights.en: 1 status point per $3 spent, with no cap
highlights.zh: 每消費 $3 累積 1 會籍積分，無上限

highlights.en: 10% more points on all card purchases with an eligible Bank of America account
highlights.zh: 持有符合條件的 Bank of America 帳戶，所有刷卡點數加贈 10%

notes: Issued by Bank of America, whose own product page is ZIP-code gated; data taken from Alaska Airlines' official card page (source_url) on 2026-11-19. That page is built from embedded content data and shows a CAPTCHA to automated browsers, so the scheduled checker may fail to re-read it — verify by hand when it reports an error. Foreign transaction fee is not stated on that page, so fx_fee is omitted.

name: Atmos™ Rewards Summit Visa Infinite® Credit Card

detail.en: eligible Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines purchases
detail.zh: 符合條件的阿拉斯加航空與夏威夷航空消費
符合條件的餐飲與海外消費

extra.en: spend must be within the first 90 days
extra.zh: 需於開卡 90 天內達成

name.en: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck® application fee

name.zh: Global Companion Award 同行獎勵票

detail.en: A 25,000-point award every anniversary, plus a 100,000-point award after $60,000 in purchases in a card year. Covers a companion's ticket, up to that many points, on award travel for two on Alaska, Hawaiian, oneworld® and partner airlines in any cabin
detail.zh: 每年週年贈 25,000 點等級一張；卡片年度消費滿 $60,000 再贈 100,000 點等級一張。兩人同行兌換獎勵機票時，折抵同行者機票所需點數（以該點數為上限），適用阿拉斯加、夏威夷、oneworld® 與夥伴航空，不限艙等

name.en: 8 Alaska Lounge day passes a year
name.zh: 每年 8 張 Alaska Lounge 單日通行證

detail.en: Two each quarter; each is valid for the whole travel day and admits up to two accompanying children
detail.zh: 每季 2 張；每張當日整趟行程有效，可帶最多 2 名同行孩童

detail.en: for you and up to 6 guests on the same reservation when the airfare is bought with the card
detail.zh: 以本卡購買機票時，本人與同一訂位最多 6 位同行者適用

detail.en: for you and up to 6 guests on the same reservation when you pay with the card
detail.zh: 以本卡付款時，本人與同一訂位最多 6 位同行者適用

detail.en: Wi-Fi, drinks and meals on Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines flights paid with the card
detail.zh: 以本卡支付阿拉斯加與夏威夷航空機上 Wi-Fi、飲品與餐點

name.zh: 航班延誤／取消 $50 抵用券

detail.en: A $50 electronic voucher when your Alaska Airlines flight is cancelled the same day or delayed 2+ hours, for any reason
detail.zh: 阿拉斯加航空航班當日取消或延誤 2 小時以上（不論原因），每次可獲 $50 電子抵用券

name.zh: 免當日確認改班手續費

detail.en: Waived regardless of your Atmos Rewards status
detail.zh: 不論 Atmos Rewards 會籍等級皆免收

name.zh: 免夥伴航空獎勵票開票費

detail.en: Taxes and partner-imposed surcharges on award tickets still apply
detail.zh: 獎勵票的稅金與夥伴航空附加費仍需自付

highlights.en: 10,000 status points every anniversary, plus 1 status point per $2 spent with no cap
highlights.zh: 每年週年贈 10,000 會籍積分；另每消費 $2 累積 1 會籍積分，無上限

highlights.en: 10% more points on all card purchases with a qualifying Bank of America account
highlights.zh: 持有符合條件的 Bank of America 帳戶，所有刷卡點數加贈 10%

highlights.en: Points transfer to hotel partner programs, including Marriott Bonvoy and Shangri-La Circle
highlights.zh: 點數可轉至飯店夥伴計畫，包含 Marriott Bonvoy 與 Shangri-La Circle

highlights.en: Share points for free with up to 10 Atmos Rewards members
highlights.zh: 可免費與最多 10 位 Atmos Rewards 會員共享點數

notes: Issued by Bank of America, whose own product page is ZIP-code gated; data taken from Alaska Airlines' official card page (source_url) on 2026-11-19. That page is built from embedded content data and shows a CAPTCHA to automated browsers, so the scheduled checker may fail to re-read it — verify by hand when it reports an error. Card image is cropped from the official image on that page (summit_concisecard.jpg) and committed as public/cards/bofa-atmos-summit.webp.
